items.title_original: 'Appalling' batting and 'wickets in clumps' leave England with ODI setback
items.summary_original: England captain Harry Brook admits his side were 'too careful' against Pakistan’s spinners after collapsing to a disappointing 87-run defeat in their ODI tri-series opener.
